message.content:
Based on the screenshot provided, here is a detailed description of the Color Circle UI component:

**(1) The Circular Rainbow Hue Disk:**
Yes, there is a prominent circular color wheel (hue disk) in the center of the "LIVE CANVAS" area. It displays a full, smooth spectrum of colors arranged radially. Starting from the top and moving clockwise, you can see **Red**, transitioning into **Orange**, then **Yellow**, **Green** (at the right side), **Cyan/Turquoise** (at the bottom), **Blue**, and **Magenta/Pink** on the left side before returning to Red. The colors are vivid and saturated.

**(2) Radial Snap Grid Lines:**
Yes, radial lines are clearly visible. Because "Snapping" is toggled **ON** and the "Grid mode" is set to **"Lines"**, thin white lines radiate from the exact center of the circle to the outer edge. 
*   **Quantity and Spacing:** There are approximately **12 lines** visible (corresponding to the "Grid divisions" value of 12 seen at the bottom right). They are spaced at regular **30-degree intervals** (360 degrees / 12 divisions). These lines act as guides to which the color markers will snap.

**(3) Harmony Markers and Overall Layout:**
*   **Markers:** Yes, there are colored harmony marker dots on the circumference of the wheel. 
    *   There is a primary marker (appearing as a white circle with a colored center) located in the **Yellow-Orange** sector (roughly at the 1 or 2 o'clock position).
    *   A second marker is located directly opposite it in the **Blue** sector (roughly at the 7 or 8 o'clock position). This layout indicates that **"Complementary"** harmony mode is currently selected in the Properties panel on the right.
*   **Controls/Panels:** 
    *   **Right Panel ("PROPERTIES"):** This panel shows the configuration. Under "Harmony," the **Complementary** option is highlighted/active. Below that, the **Snapping** toggle switch is yellow (active). The **Grid mode** is set to **Lines** (selected over "Dots").
    *   **Left Panel ("LIBRARY"):** Shows the navigation tree, with **Color > Color Circle** currently selected.
*   **Visual Appearance:** The interface uses a dark theme (dark purple/black background) with high-contrast text and bright accent colors (yellow for active states). The overall look is clean, modern, and typical of a developer tool or design system documentation (labeled "Workshop v0.1").
